measurement.method: Fixed nine Git-tracked owned production files parsed with installed TypeScript7 native inventory worker in a closed virtual filesystem. No engine execution, type resolution, account/config/network reads or build. Physical lines include blanks/comments via scope.mjs. Function complexity is 1+owned syntax decisions excluding nested functions. Exact body AST fingerprints retain identifiers/operators/literals. Metrics prioritize manual review and do not prove unused behavior.
measurement.qualification: 9/9 scoped files measured without read/parse/unsupported/change failures. This is not the final repository inventory: final RF-01 source capture and RF-02 ownership/caller review follow feature integration.
